cases.question: How many orders are in the database?
Who are the top 5 customers by how much they actually spent? Exclude cancelled orders and subtract any refunds.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What is the total revenue per product category, excluding cancelled orders?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: What is the average order value for completed orders?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS total_amount_cents FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id)

cases.question: Which products were sold for less than their current list price, and what is the largest gap?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT p.name, p.list_price_cents / 100.0 AS list_price, oi.unit_price_cents / 100.0 AS sold_price, (p.list_price_cents - oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 AS gap FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price_cents < p.list_price_cents ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: How many orders came through each channel in the first quarter of 2026?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY channel

cases.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: What percentage of non-cancelled orders ended up with a refund?
cases.agent_sql: WITH non_cancelled_orders AS (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'), refunded_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM refunds) SELECT (COUNT(refunded_orders.order_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(non_cancelled_orders.id)) AS refund_percentage FROM non_cancelled_orders LEFT JOIN refunded_orders ON non_cancelled_orders.id = refunded_orders.order_id;
